scope: Fixed-base Panda, real PhysX simulation only; no physical robot
comparison_rules: Only compare algorithm improvement within equal geometry, gravity, material and solver settings
Soft material is an environment condition, not a controller improvement
EMA is used for feedback only, never as evaluation signal
Identical deterministic repeats do not establish statistical significance
Known surface height for braking is simulated prior knowledge, not visual inference
No claim of industrial robustness or full-duration constant force from a 0.5s window
